issue.body:
## Summary
Implements ATOM 7 for issue #425. Native browser tooltip delays are removed only from toast/notification-related hover surfaces. Custom hints appear synchronously on pointer entry and keyboard focus, with no timers or CSS transitions. Persistent notification toasts remain independent from the temporary hint.

## Audit map and delay sources

| Surface | Selector / owner | Text source | Before / delay source | After / close |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Topbar influence | `#balance [data-profile-stat="influence"] .statIcon`; `ui-core.js::syncTopbarStatTitles` | Active UI profile stat-title map | Native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay | Reusable `#statHoverHint` on pointerenter/focusin; pointerleave/focusout hides only the hint |
| Topbar reputation | `#balance [data-profile-stat="rep"] .statIcon`; same owner | Active UI profile stat-title map | Native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay | Same immediate custom hint; uses synchronized current-profile text |
| Topbar balance | `#balance [data-profile-stat="points"] .statIcon`; same owner | Active UI profile stat-title map | Native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay | Same immediate custom hint |
| Topbar wins | `#balance [data-profile-stat="wins"] .statIcon`; same owner | Active UI profile stat-title map | Native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay | Same immediate custom hint |
| Points-cap messages | `.pointsWrap`, `#mePoints`, `#mePointsOverflow`; `ui-core.js` stat render/cap path | Existing `Game.Data.CAP_MESSAGES.points` | Dynamic native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay | Cap text is exposed through the same immediate custom hint |
| Weekly reputation-cap message | `#meRepNeed`; `ui-core.js` stat render/cap path | Existing `Game.Data.CAP_MESSAGES.rep` | Dynamic native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay | Existing message via immediate custom hint |
| Lottery top-menu action | `#btnLotteryTop`; `ui-menu.js::applyMenuLabels` | Existing localized unavailable text | Native `title`; browser-managed tooltip delay; click path separately uses the existing lottery toast | Immediate custom hint on pointer/focus; existing click and `showLotteryToast` behavior preserved |

Internal stat/action/delta/lottery notification toasts are application-owned persistent nodes, not delayed native hover surfaces. Their show and click-dismiss mechanisms were audited and left intact. Unrelated battle-control titles were not changed. No Safari tooltip timing control is attempted.

## Changed files

- `AsyncScene/Web/index.html`, `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-core.js`, `AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-menu.js`, `AsyncScene/Web/style-base.css`
- Matching docs surfaces: `docs/index.html`, `docs/ui/ui-core.js`, `docs/ui/ui-menu.js`, `docs/style-base.css`
- `tools/test_stage6_instant_stat_hover_hints.py`

The docs menu file had unrelated pre-existing drift from Web; it was preserved, and the ATOM 7 hint change itself is synchronized.

## Verification

- New executable regression: `python3 tools/test_stage6_instant_stat_hover_hints.py` - PASS, 11 checks covering immediate no-timer hint contract, title removal, keyboard focus, hint-only pointerleave, five profile copy maps, independent/click-dismiss persistent toasts, no auto-dismiss, reusable hint node, touch behavior, and mirror parity.
- Stage 6: `python3 tools/test_stage6_step9_click_persistent_stat_toast.py` - PASS.
- Stage 6: `python3 tools/test_stage6_step9_five_profile_runtime_defects.py` - PASS.
- Stage 7.15: `python3 tools/test_stage7_15_31_oleg_escape_lifecycle.py` - PASS.
- Stage 7.15: `python3 tools/test_stage7_15_23_nastya_crowd_vote.py` - PASS.
- Syntax: `node --check AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-core.js`, `node --check AsyncScene/Web/ui/ui-menu.js`, and `python3 -m py_compile tools/test_stage6_instant_stat_hover_hints.py` - PASS.
- `git diff --check` - PASS.
- Web/docs core surfaces are byte-identical. Existing profile labels were checked in Codex In-app Browser for all five UI profiles. Keyboard focus displayed the same custom hint in the live page; the Alpha UI exposed its localized `репа` label, which exposed and led to fixing the stale-text source before publication. Persistent startup stat toasts were visible as separate clickable nodes; clicking one removed only that node.
- Browser used: embedded Codex In-app Browser against the local checkout at `http://127.0.0.1:8097/AsyncScene/index.html`. No Playwright CLI, external browser, or Safari acceptance was used.

## Invariants

No resource-award mechanics, economy, stat delta timing, `COALESCE_MS = 90`, NPC/training scenario, or persistent notification copy changed. Persistent toasts still require a click, remain independent, can coexist, and are unaffected by pointerleave. Existing lottery and action toast behavior remains intact.

## Revision

- Parent/main baseline: `28b6a25ce9459b8ab223b72d7dc9977d785c46bd`
- PR head: `e6d5c2296a118e4134f521a8457109a9700d3c5b`
- Local verified commit has the same tree as the published head.
- Safari PASS: not claimed. No known remaining implementation limitation.

Closes #425
